result.instructions: Tools for Benchling, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the DNA sequences in the cloning project and show their lengths."; "Find notebook entries modified this week in project Assay Development."; "Create a folder called Plasmid Maps inside folder lib_abc123.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Benchling data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run benchling_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run benchling_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run benchling_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. benchling_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: benchling_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects in the tenant (GET /projects). Use to find a projectId for other list calls.

next_token.description: nextToken from the previous page, to get the next page.

project_id.description: The project id, for example from a list call.

tools.name: benchling_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List folders (GET /folders). Filter by projectId, parent folder, or name.

parent_folder_id.description: Only folders directly inside this folder.

name_includes.description: Folders whose name contains this text.

next_token.description: nextToken from the previous page, to get the next page.

folder_id.description: The folder id, for example from a list call.

tools.name: benchling_list_entries
tools.title: List notebook entries
tools.description: List notebook entries (GET /entries). Filter by project, schema, name, or modifiedAt (ISO time, Benchling filter syntax).

schema_id.description: Only entries that use this schema id.

modified_at.description: Benchling modifiedAt filter, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z or a range.

next_token.description: nextToken from the previous page, to get the next page.

tools.name: benchling_get_entry
tools.title: Get a notebook entry
tools.description: Get one notebook entry by id (GET /entries/{entry_id}).

entry_id.description: The entry id, for example from a list call.

tools.name: benchling_list_dna_sequences
tools.title: List DNA sequences
tools.description: List DNA sequences (GET /dna-sequences). Filter by project, folder, registry, schema, or name.

schema_id.description: Only sequences that use this schema id.

name_includes.description: Sequences whose name contains this text.

next_token.description: nextToken from the previous page, to get the next page.

tools.name: benchling_get_dna_sequence
tools.title: Get a DNA sequence
tools.description: Get one DNA sequence by id, including its bases (GET /dna-sequences/{dna_sequence_id}).

dna_sequence_id.description: The DNA sequence id, for example from a list call.

tools.name: benchling_list_registries
tools.title: List registries
tools.description: List registries (GET /registries). Use to find a registryId for DNA sequence and entity calls.

tools.name: benchling_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the tenant (GET /users). Filter by name or by team membership.

name_includes.description: Users whose name contains this text.

member_of.description: Only members of this team id.

next_token.description: nextToken from the previous page, to get the next page.

user_id.description: The user id, for example from a list call.

tools.name: benchling_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams (GET /teams), optionally filtered by name or organization.

name_includes.description: Teams whose name contains this text.

organization_id.description: Only teams in this organization id.

next_token.description: nextToken from the previous page, to get the next page.

tools.name: benchling_create_folder
tools.title: Create a folder
tools.description: Create a folder inside a parent folder (POST /folders). Creates a new record in the tenant; it does not change existing records.

parent_folder_id.description: Id of the folder that will contain the new folder.

prompts.name: review_notebook_entries_changed_this_week

prompts.name: look_up_a_teammate_s_profile
